text: The Glass Knight is a being featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. She was originally a human paladin who, after being injured too badly to ever go back into battle, chose to have her spirit imbued into a glass golem rather than live out the rest of her years unable to defend Gilneas. Normally these golems are in stasis and a part of the Gilnean church's stained glass windows, but they wake up when the city needs defending.
The Formless Void is an Azerite Essence obtained from the Ny'alotha, the Waking City raid.

]] The Gift of Cheese is a profession achievement earned by sharing the Recipe Rat's greatest recipe, Charitable Cheddar, with hungry rats across Azeroth. Dragon Isles cooks with at least 50 skill can acquire Ratcipe: Charitable Cheddar by finding the Squeaking Swiss at inside a crate in the Obsidian Rest of northern Zaralek Cavern, not far from Koshlahki, the cooking supplies vendor, to pick up the Recipe Rat (item)#Zaralek Cavern. With some Fine Aged Cheddar available, use the item on cooldown to pick up 2-7 scraps, then combine 30 scraps into the recipe. Making 50 servings will require roughly: * 50x Fine Aged Cheddar, sold by many vendors, including Elaine Trias in Stormwind City and Miw

"The Guardians of Tirisfal" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter II. It is set 2,700 years before Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. Found at: *Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City *Filthy Animal (on 2nd floor) in Dalaran *Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran * The Guardian's Library in Karazhan Timeline: * ← Previous book: Arathor and the Troll Wars * → Next book: Ironforge - the Awakening of the Dwarves
The Heart of Quagmirran is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest WANTED: The Heart of Quagmirran. The quest is a random daily heroic quest from Wind Trader Zhareem in Lower City.
The Headfeathers of Ikiss is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest WANTED: The Headfeathers of Ikiss. The quest is a random daily heroic quest from Wind Trader Zhareem in Lower City.
The Horseman's Reins teaches you to summon the Headless Horseman's Mount, which serves both as a flying mount and a ground mount. The saddle is buried in the cemetery of the Scarlet Monastery.
This quest ends the Battle for Gilneas City quest chain, and begins the Breaking Waves of Change chain.
The Immortal Vanguard is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Galakras in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance without having allowed a single friendly NPC to perish in battle.

The Guardian's Sanctum, also known as the Guardian Sanctum, is an area of the Tomb of Sargeras originally built by the renegade Guardian Aegwynn around 600 BDP. After the Tirisgarde discovered Aegwynn's previous stronghold — the tower of Karazhan — and reported its location back to the Council of Tirisfal, she magically sealed off the tower and set out to locate a new refuge hidden from both the Tirisgarde and the council. After much consideration, she decided to build the Guardian Sanctum in the sunken ruins of Suramar, where it would remain hidden from the Tirisgarde for centuries. Aegwynn remained safe in her sanctum for hundreds of years and only rarely emerged to walk the outside world,
The Heart's Power was available when you reached reputation with the Champions of Azeroth prior to patch 8.2.0. Note that you would NOT get any hint or introduction that you've unlocked it.

Death Gate is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Upon use, Lord Darion Mograine, King Thoras Trollbane, High Inquisitor Whitemane or Nazgrim will show up to lend a helping hand for 10 minutes.

The Last Guardian is a novel by Jeff Grubb taking place in the Warcraft universe during the beginning of the First War. An audiobook version read by Dick Hill was scheduled to be released in April, 2009.

"The Invasion of Draenor" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter IV. It recounts the events of Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal. Found at: * Scholomance - room before Viewing Room **At the beginning of the instance, kill the guards. Walk up to the iron gate, then jump over the balcony to your left. The book is on the wall that runs around the room. Level 80 spellcasters beware: many of the mobs in this room are magic immune. Timeline: * ← Previous book: The Alliance of Lordaeron * → Next book: The Birth of the Lich King

The Largest Panda Ever is a panda which can be encountered in the Brothers in Blood mission of Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos in Eternity's End campaign. He is immune to magic, and fittingly, he drops a Necklace of Spell Immunity when killed. This item is very useful in the last mission.

The Light Stands Strong is a short story in the World of Warcraft Official Strategy Guide. A paladin defends Darkshire from an attacking abomination. Warned by the town crier, while the city militia, the Night Watch rallied, the paladin, along with a warrior, priest, and night elf rogue began to battle the monster. The rogue had died during the battle, but the paladin was able to call him back to life. They had all stood up against one of the worst horrors they had ever encountered. He vowed to one day reclaim Duskwood, so that all its citizens could roam in its tranquil gardens and bright glades again.

The Lady's Necklace starts when a player activates the drop of the same name, which can be found in Windrunner Spire. This is the first quest of the "Lady's Necklace quest chain", which will lead the blood elf player from Tranquillien to Undercity and later to the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Imbued with dark magics, it is said that whoever holds the Legacy Heart shall never die. Indeed, its current owner bears the title of "the Undying."
The Journal of Val'zareq drops from Val'zareq the Conqueror in Shadowmoon Valley.
This quest starts (and ends) a phase of The Argent Vanguard and the Valley of Echoes, where the scourge attack, with Nerubians, scourge of various sorts, and Frostbrood Destroyers.

The Keymaster was an achievement to collect the keys listed. Though the achievement was introduced during the Wrath of the Lich King expansion, most of the keys originate from vanilla World of Warcraft or the Burning Crusade expansion. Unlike other removed achievements, it was not converted into a Feat of Strength.

The Iron Invasion is a feat of strength achievement awarded for completing the pre-expansion launch Warlords of Draenor intro experience quest chain in the Blasted Lands, culminating in the quests Report to the King and Warning the Warchief. Though the quests remained in-game, the achievement was no longer awarded after the release of Warlords of Draenor.

The Last of Us is a Feats of Strength achievement rewarded for being the last standing player at the Highmaul Coliseum and gives the title Lord of War / Lady of War. A Level 3 Gladiator's Sanctum building is required to access the Highmaul Coliseum.
The Invasion Begins begins the demon hunter starting experience. When the player takes his/her first steps, several fellow Illidari will teleport into Mardum to join the party.
The Light's Gift is Defender Illona's quest to unlock an additional ability once you gain Trusted Bodyguard status with her.
The Kleptoboss is an alarm-o-bot located on Mechagon Island.
The Last Voidtalon is a dead void dread raven located in the Edge of Reality in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds. Next to it is a Voidtalon Egg.

, and Wrathion atop the Seat of the Aspects]] The Land Beneath begins the Embers of Neltharion campaign, starting the patch 10.1 portion of the Dragonflight campaign. This breadcrumb quest to Zaralek Cavern will be pushed to max-level players, who have completed A Creche Divided, automatically after logging in.
__NOTOC__ The Lightning Capacitor is an epic trinket for DPS casters.For some classes and specs it was said to be the most powerful trinket in the game.

The Maiden's Fancy was a Blackwater Raiders vessel with a mixed-race crew that sailed between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, respectively between the Steamwheedle Cartel ports of Ratchet and Booty Bay. It had no problems with the Bloodsail coming near them, the ship having a large amount of gunpowder in the hold for "insurance". The Maiden's Fancy was shown to be destroyed during the Cataclysm, when a tidal wave hit Booty Bay, but it is still available in-game.
The Macho Gnome's Arrow was a powerful type of arrow that was only available during the patch 2.0.1 PTR to aid raid guilds with testing. It is not in the live client.

The Loremaster is a meta quest achievement earned for completing a high number of quests in each continent of the game. Daily quests do not count toward this achievement; some other repeatable quests only count the first time they're completed.
The Mask Task is related to the seasonal world event Hallow's End. If you destroy the mask you have received, the criteria stay completed. Note that masks are BoP and cannot be traded.
The Marine Marine is a Feat of Strength for acquiring a Heavy Murloc Egg from BlizzCon 2009.
The Metal Paw is a pandaren vendor found in Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit. He sells weapons and armor for all classes and specs, prefixed with "Mountainscaler".

The Lucid is a title granted after killing Iyyokuk the Lucid and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. Only healers can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Ingenious. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Lucid

The Locust is a title granted after killing Ka'roz the Locust and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. All players can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Strong Legs. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Locust

The Lost Vikings franchise was one of the first game series created by Silicon & Synapse (later Blizzard Entertainment). It was a humorous puzzle-platform video game franchise, with the first game having been originally released for the Super NES in 1993. In The Lost Vikings, the player controlled three separate vikings with different abilities. The three vikings had to work together to finish each level and find their way back home. A sequel, The Lost Vikings 2, was released in 1997. In 2014, the first game was added to Battle.net as a free download which is emulated through DOSBox. The first game was re-released in its originals and definitive versions in the Blizzard Arcade Collection on

The Magic of Azeroth book explains in detail each spell in the game Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and its expansion. It was released in 1996 along with the Warcraft II: Edition Deluxe. It contains two sections: "The Orcish Spells" and "The Human Spells".
The Missing Chapter is looted from Jewelhammer's Chest in Jewelhammer's Vault under Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. The chest is guarded by a Vault Guardian.

The Lonely Matriarch is a massive silkstrider located on the Forgotten Retreat, an island west of Ardenweald. Marasmius asks his mushroomancer to soothe her, and a Discarded Harp nearby can help. In response, she weaves a Very Large Silk Bundle containing the Giant Silk Bundle.

The Long Summer is a conduit for paladins. It drops from the following bosses: *Tred'ova in the Mists of Tirna Scithe *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthening the Bond (Night Fae).
The Magistrate's Judgment is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Magistrate's Judgment.
The Mad Duke's Tea is a soulbind ability for the Venthyr Covenant when binded to Theotar.
The Mad Paragon is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Mad Paragon.
The Pacifier is a very slow two-handed mace that provides bonuses to strength and stamina.

__NOTOC__ The Nameless Prophet is a centaur located in the tunnels outside Maraudon in Desolace. He can cause major issues for single characters moving through the pre-instance area. He has three spawn points and rotates through them. The Prophet is the highest of any tribe in spiritual matters and is one of the oldest of any tribe. He is powerful, and communicates with the spirits of centaur ancestors.

[http://www.albatrosbits.com/murloc.php The Murloc is Lonely] is an in-progress fan trilogy, written by Albatros and located at his website, [http://www.albatrosbits.com/ Albatros Bits]. It follows several characters based on World of Warcraft Community Managers (e.g. Fangtooth and Caydiem) which work for the mysterious, all-powerful, and clearly-allegorical Law. Despite its inclusion of CM characters, its scope and tone are fairly epic, and growing moreso as the trilogy progresses. (It's currently about a third of the way through its second book, The Emerald Queen - believed to be a reference to Ysera.) The story is set 700 years in Warcraft's future, and so makes lots of assumptions, but s

The Ocular is an eye floating just above the Shadow Vault. It is used by the Lich King to watch the surrounding area of Icecrown. Players destroy the Ocular in It's All Fun and Games, given by their faction's death knights on the gunships above the glacier before reporting to Baron Sliver to do the bidding of Knights of the Ebon Blade. __NOTOC__
The Old Wizard's Almanac is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
The Oceanographer (see ) is a fishing achievement. It is not part of the Accomplished Angler achievement. To complete it you have to successfully catch each of the 31 listed saltwater fish.

The Pandaren Problem is a lore object found at on the mainland immediately northeast of the Violet Rise island on the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Rumbles of Thunder.
The Mothergloop is a ooze featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. She has plenty of oozes and is able to empower them fast.
The Natural Order's Will is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Natural Order.

__NOTOC__ The Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad was a quest item dropped by Kel'Thuzad was defeated in Naxxramas when it was a level 60 raid in the Eastern Plaguelands. Similar to the Head of Onyxia or Heart of Hakkar, one was guaranteed to drop on every kill. In Wrath of the Lich King, it was revealed that Father Inigo Montoy (an Argent Dawn priest from the original game) took the phylactery to Northrend, giving Kel'Thuzad time to regenerate so he could once again rule Naxxramas.

__NOTOC__ The Razza is a rare chimaera found in the south-eastern region in Feralas at the Lower Wilds. He flies around in a destroyed Woodpaw gnoll camp. Previously, he used to be in the central arena in Dire Maul. This chimaera is a rare tamable spawn with a unique grey skin.
The Red Ridge Mountains is the fifth mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.

.]] The Regrowth is the beginnings of the forest that once was, before it became an inferno that destroyed all of it in Mount Hyjal. The wildlife once again scatter the lands and life begins a new. The land, thanks to adventurers and Rayne Feathersong, have been protected with firewards to prevent the elementals from entering and interfering again. This happens after completing the quest Aessina's Miracle at the Grove of Aessina. The areas of the the Inferno and the Flamewake become the Regrowth and all enemies that existed in the areas (including in Ashen Lake) are removed. Nordu by now has been burned to ash and has also been removed. Tortolla, Niden, and some guards move down to the borde

The Poisoned Mind is a title granted after killling Xaril the Poisoned Mind and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. Only healers can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Vast Apothecarial Knowledge. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Poisoned Mind

the Prime is a title granted after killing Korven the Prime and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. Only tanks can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Master of Amber. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Prime

The Primus Returns concludes the "The Last Sigil" chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, rewarding the Memories of Sunless Skies, which unlocks flight in the four level-up zones of Shadowlands. Bolvar offers an immediate followup: Storming the Sanctum, serving as a breadcrumb to the Sanctum of Domination. The storyline continues with The Chains of Command at :Renown 47.
The Penitent One is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Penitent One.

The Pilgrimage Ends concludes "Forging a New Path", the fourth chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign, and unlocks access to the two special Ancient Translocators connecting the Sepulcher of the First Ones to mainland Zereth Mortis—the only way of reaching the physical raid entrance without flying. The fifth chapter, "Crown of Wills", begins with The Broken Crown back in Haven.
The Perfect Pebble is a feat of strength in , earned for obtaining a Glowing Pebble from Pebble's Pebble.
The Red and the Black Flights can be found in the Life-Binder Conservatory while on Library of Alexstrasza.
In The Sacred Flame, you will journey to Ashenvale to steal a vial of water from a moonwell, which is needed to douse a sacred fire of the centaur in Thousand Needles.
The Scroll of Skyriss is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest WANTED: The Scroll of Skyriss. The quest is a random daily heroic quest from Wind Trader Zhareem in Lower City.
The Riptide is the westernmost of the three Bloodsail Buccaneers frigates docked at Wild Shore islands in Cape of Stranglethorn.

This article deals with the incredibly long and involved quest chain to create The Scepter of the Shifting Sands, used to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. As of Cataclysm 4.0.1 this chain has been completely removed from the game. Anyone who finished Treasure of the Timeless One prior to Cataclysm release was rewarded with the Feat of Strength Veteran of the Shifting Sands.
The Sanctum Wards is part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline. Once players have recovered the Sun's Reach Sanctum, Arm the Wards! replaces this quest.
The Sea Boar was a drinking establishment in Hasic frequented by the gryphon-flying dwarves.

"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Illusion" is a book in Dalaran which is related to the Higher Learning achievement. When it is not pretending to be a ham sandwich, it can be found in the north corner of Violet Hold (left as you come in off the street).

The Schools of Arcane Magic are a series of in-game books relating to the achievement. They were written by the notable . They can be found only in the Northrend Dalaran and, unlike most books, despawn after being read. In total, there are eight locations where books can spawn. After reading any book, it starts a three-minute timer. The book despawns when that timer expires, but until then can be read by any number of other players, making "group hunts" for these books reasonable. Respawn appears to occur three hours, three and a half hours, or four hours after the book despawns, but it isn't always the same book which appears. Instead, a book appears to be chosen at random from the set of b

"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Enchantment" is a book in Dalaran which is related to the Higher Learning achievement. This book spawns on the second floor of The Threads of Fate on the balcony outside atop a crate.

"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Transmutation" is a book in Dalaran which is related to the Higher Learning achievement. Drunken Dalaran mages often leave it in the empty bookshelf near the west entrance of the Legerdemain Lounge.
"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Abjuration" is a rare book that spawns in Dalaran Visitor Center. It is a requirement of the Higher Learning achievement.

"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Necromancy" is a book in Dalaran which is related to the Higher Learning achievement. You can dig this up out of the bookshelf in the second floor common room of the Legerdemain Lounge.

"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Conjuration" is a book in Dalaran, which is related to the Higher Learning achievement, on the ground floor of the Violet Citadel, on a bookshelf behind Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at and .
"The Schools of Arcane Magic - Introduction" is a book in Dalaran which is related to the Higher Learning achievement. It can occasionally be found on the floor in the Violet Gate.

The Sea Wolf is a Horde destroyer sent on a mission to siege Theramore Isle, however, their mission failed. The adventurers that traveled along with them are sent on a few tasks to salvage the situation.

The Search For Fact, Not Truth is about something. Here, you write briefly what that something is. Mention any prerequisites or special notes about the achievement here. Must have 300 fishing skill. Can only be completed during Brewfest. Prerequisite achievements should be mentioned in the section below. The title is in reference (like much of the archaeology profession) to Indiana Jones. The quote comes from Jones himself in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.
The Sea Jewel was a cursed pirate destroyer. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Rusty Prince is a rare that can encountered in the future alternate timeline of Mechagon Island. He is a fully mechanized version of Prince Erazmin.
__NOTOC__ The Scrap King is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island. His boar mount, named the same, must be killed first before he can be engaged.
The Rotten is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Rotten.
The Schools of Arcane Magic - Mastery is awarded from completing the Higher Learning achievement in Dalaran.

"The Sentinels and the Long Vigil" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter I. Found at: * Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale - upstairs from "Sea Wolf" MacKinley * Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas - inside the Inn on the way to the docks Timeline: * ← Previous book: Exile of the High Elves * → Next book: The Founding of Quel'Thalas

The Seven were Dark Iron dwarves of great knowledge and power and the patriarchs of the Dark Iron nation. They were the dwarves who, along with Thaurissan, summoned Ragnaros the Firelord to Azeroth. Though they died during the summoning and their people became enslaved by Ragnaros as a result, they seem to think that coming of the Firelord is a blessing.
__NOTOC__ The Shatterer is main-hand mace. It used to have a disarm proc.

The Sin'loren is one of three blood elven destroyers in the waters north of the Sun's Reach Harbor, Isle of Quel'Danas. The Sin'loren is the southernmost ship of the fleet. This ship is one of three containing Dawnblade blood elves, as reinforcements for the Sunfury on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

The Skull of Tyrannistrasz is exhibited in the Ironforge museum. Many archaeologists in the Explorers' League support the idea of returning the skull to Tyrannistrasz' people, the red dragonflight. __NOTOC__

The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm is a World of Warcraft novel by Christie Golden, released on October 19, 2010. The story told in the novel leads up to the events of the Cataclysm expansion in a manner similar to that of Arthas: Rise of the Lich King and World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King.
"The Shattering" is the main theme of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, and was composed by Russell Brower.

The Skyhorn is a massive horn and the most sacred artifact of the Skyhorn tribe, found atop Windripper Peak in Highmountain. A group of Crawliac harpies led by Agna the Fowl are attempting to steal the horn, forcing Lasan Skyhorn to ask for aid from adventurers.
The Shadow Hunter is a destroyer located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

The Slumbering Emperor is an ardenmoth located northwest of the road between Hibernal Hollow and Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald. It's hidden within a Strange Cloud that makes you start to fall asleep as soon as you draw near. To disperse the cloud, you must engage the Emperor in combat. There are various methods to do this, including... *Using certain abilities that reveal invisible targets (such as Spectral Sight), then hitting it with a ranged attack; *Tossing a ranged AoE (such as Wild Spirits) into the center of the cloud; *Or afflicting yourself with a periodic damage effect (such as a Thorny Loop or the nearby Greater Ardenmoths' poison) to stave off the sleep debuff, so you can run in and u
The Fifth Clue is located at the edge of the moonwell in Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
The Sunwell Trilogy is a manga trilogy set in the Warcraft universe. *Written by Richard A. Knaak. *Art by Kim Jae-Hwan. *Covers by Kim Jae-Hwan. *Published by Tokyopop.

The Stoppable Force is a -quality mace. It has a counterpart shield called The Movable Object. This item is needed to buy Topaz Baubleworm from Keeper Ta'hult. It is an obvious reference to the epic Alterac Valley reward hammer called The Unstoppable Force.

The Sunwell Trilogy - Ultimate Edition is a hardback collection of the original english manga trilogy written by Richard Knaak and illustrated by Kim Jae-Hwan taking place in the Warcraft universe. It contains the following volumes: # Dragon Hunt # Shadows of Ice # Ghostlands It also includes a new eight-page, full-color prologue about the creation of the Sunwell, as well as an art gallery, design sketchbook, and afterword by Chris Metzen.

The Stormbreaker is a destroyer docked inside Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. It acts as a stationary bridge between the northern and southern halves of the keep. The ship made several trips between Valiance Keep and the Eastern Kingdoms, delivering medical supplies to the Valiance Expedition. Unbeknownst to the ship's captain, "Lefty" Lugsail, Cult of the Damned members from the mainland used the Stormbreaker and other Alliance ships to gain passage to Northrend. A Cultist Shrine can be found below deck.

The Three Winds is an ethereal-run shop found within the Canals in Stormwind City. Formerly the location of The Finest Thread, it is located behind The Stockade, across the water and bordering Cathedral Square. Utilizing their ethereal technomancy to create a lucrative business, the ethereal offer a variety of services here, including void storage, transmogrification, and item upgrades.
The Strength of Steel is a short story by Raphael Ahad that is featured on the official site. .]]

The Swarmkeeper is a title granted after killing Hisek the Swarmkeeper and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. Only DPS can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Compound Eye. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Swarmkeeper

The Steel Sentinel is the second boss of the Hall of Explorers wing in the League of Explorers adventure of Hearthstone. It is the armor of Anduin Lothar, recovered by Brann Bronzebeard from Blackrock Mountain, which has been animated by Arch-Thief Rafaam and the Staff of Origination. According to Brann, it cost him months of sifting through dragon dung to recover the armor.
The Strength of Iron starts the profession quest line for blacksmiths to unlock 700 skill and The Forge for your garrison.
The Storm Rages is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Shattering Bolts and Chain Reaction (artifact trait) traits.

.]] The Sunstrider is a blood elven destroyer that transports infantry from Durotar to Azuremyst Isle to aid in the quest to invade Argus. The captain of the ship is Fleet Admiral Zar'gov. Lady Liadrin, Aethas Sunreaver, Silgryn, and the adventurer boarded it from Bladefist Bay to get to the Azuremyst.
The Surging Mist is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

__NOTOC__ The Tarragrue is an extremely powerful charred behemoth, a relentless beast that has stalked the halls of Torghast since the tower's first spire was raised. He has trampled countless souls to ash. During Torghast runs, he can be seen behind a wall on certain floors, watching the players but unable to attack. He also serves as a boss in the Sanctum of Domination raid. Prior to patch 9.1, the Tarragrue played a much larger role during Torghast runs. If the player or group reached a certain number of deaths in a single run, the Tarragrue would appear at the current level's entrance and begin slowly moving toward the exit. If he spotted any players, he would hunt them down and kill the
The Taskmaster's Wristwraps drop from Skullhat in a cave in the Haglands in Highmountain.
The Spectral Hands of Arcadne is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Stone Ward is an anima power that can be chosen after defeating Soggodon the Breaker in Mythic+ dungeons with the Tormented affix.
The Stygian King's Barbs is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

.]] :"What happens when . . . ?" The Unstoppable Force is an two handed mace obtained from the Stormpike Guard faction, or the Frostwolf Clan faction, for . It is also the counter to The Immovable Object.
The Unforgiven (named Lylia in life) is an elite wraith in Stratholme. Not much is known about The Unforgiven, but some have mentioned her mask is a truly powerful item.
The Twin Stars is a set that includes a ring and a necklace. They both drop from mobs in the Karazhan raid and level 70 5-man dungeons.
The Twilight Plot begins the Uldum storyline along with Fly Over, available in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm as soon as players reach level 83.

The Verne is a goblin submarine operating in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir, commanded by (and presumably named for) Captain "Jewels" Verne. It temporarily ports at the Horde base camp at the Tenebrous Cavern until Defending the Rift, when it is destroyed by the naga and their faceless allies.
The Twilight Destroyer - Guild Edition is criteria for the meta achievement Glory of the Lich King Raider.

This article is a copy of "The Undead Plague," an official article by Blizzard Entertainment. It presented information about the Plague of Undeath. The original article, formerly located at [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/story/undeadplague.html http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/story/undeadplague.html], did not survive the overhaul of the World of Warcraft Official Website. The devastating undead plague began in Northrend after the Second War. There, from the depths of the Frozen Throne, the Lich King Ner'zhul afflicted a remote human village through his will alone: a morbid test meant to gauge the plague's effectiveness. The infected villagers died, and when their zombified corpses

For the novels by Richard A. Knaak, see War of the Ancients Trilogy. The Wavecrest is a Silver Covenant destroyer located in the middle of the Sea Reaver's Run just off the northern coast of Icecrown and east of its Sunreaver companion, the Firehawk. During the war against the Lich King, Captain Elleane Wavecrest and her crew of Wavecrest Mariners, fought off-boarding Kvaldir Harpooners and Kvaldir Berserkers, in addition to attacks from the North Sea Kraken. At some point, they had to slay the kraken they kept summoning, with the help of adventurers. And when they weren't fighting, they were fishing for sharks.

Thelgen Rock is an area in the southern Wetlands that is crawling with poisonous spiders. The name refers to an extensive cavern that stretches deep into the mountains. Frustrated cartographers can also be seen roaming the area trying in vain to explore the last piece of their maps.

Threat per second (TPS) is a measure of the threat generated by a person over one second. Dealing damage, healing, and many tanking abilities serve to increase threat generation. Because Damage dealers need to keep their threat below that of the tank's, the DPS of the group is limited (capped) by the TPS of the tank. In many situations, the only viable way for the group to increase DPS is for the tank to increase TPS. Many threat meters, such as the Omen addon, measure threat in terms of TPS.

Threat of Thassarian is a death knight talent. This is a key passive that makes dual wielding viable for death knights. Normally only the main hand weapon is taken in to account for abilities that deal damage based on weapon damage, such as Frost Strike and Obliterate, severely reducing their damage when dual wielding instead of using a 2-hander. This passive 'fixes' that problem for frost death knights.
